posts.caption:
Apparently Pandora is trending again, so I dug out a few old pieces and cleaned them 😂
This silver-cleaning trick is super easy: line a bowl with foil, add a spoonful of baking soda and a little salt, then pour in boiling water.
After about 10 seconds they already looked way shinier 😭✨
I rinsed them with clean water, rubbed off the remaining spots with a tissue, and they were sparkling again.
I used to collect Pandora like crazy, so I already know I’m about to find a whole pile more to clean 🫢

My sister bought this cockroach costume and the second my cat saw it, he went straight into full battle mode 💀
I cannot stop replaying his reaction 😂
